prompt: A real candid street photograph, not cinematic and not glossy, showing an ordinary young man dressed as Superman in a realistic textured blue suit with a red cape and a large red-and-gold S emblem on the chest. He stands in the foreground on a city street, facing the camera with a calm slight smile, short dark hair, trimmed beard, and clear eyeglasses. His right arm is raised straight upward, effortlessly holding up a full-size silver-and-blue city bus with one hand; his fingers wrap around a small dark metal support point underneath the bus, making the bus appear suspended above him. The bus dominates the upper half of the frame, seen from a low angle with its front corner, headlights, license plate, underside, large wheels, and side panels visible. Add pedestrians on the sidewalk in the background reacting with surprise, including a small group watching and one person holding up a phone. Urban downtown setting with tall buildings, storefronts, pavement, curb, and natural daylight. Make it look like an authentic smartphone or documentary photo with realistic lighting, slight wide-angle perspective, natural shadows, imperfect street details, and believable scale. Avoid comic-book style, studio lighting, glossy superhero poster effects, dramatic cinematic color grading, exaggerated muscles, or artificial CGI polish.

promptZh: 一张真实的纪实街拍照片，非电影感且无光泽感，画面展示了 一名普通年轻人 打扮成超人的样子，身穿质感写实的蓝色制服，披着红色斗篷，胸前有巨大的红金配色 S 标志。他站在城市街道的前景中，面向镜头，带着平静的浅笑，留着深色短发，修剪整齐的胡须，戴着透明眼镜。他的右臂向上笔直伸展，单手轻松地托举着一辆全尺寸的银蓝色城市公交车；他的手指扣在公交车下方的一个小型深色金属支撑点上，使公交车看起来悬浮在他上方。公交车占据了画面的上半部分，采用低角度拍摄，清晰可见其前角、前大灯、车牌、底盘、大车轮和侧板。背景的人行道上有行人表现出惊讶的反应，包括一小群围观者和一名正在举起手机拍摄的人。场景位于城市中心，周围有高楼、店面、人行道、路缘石和自然光。使其看起来像是一张真实的智能手机拍摄照片或纪录片照片，具有写实的灯光、轻微的广角透视、自然的阴影、不完美的街道细节以及可信的比例。避免漫画风格、影棚灯光、光泽感超级英雄海报效果、戏剧性的电影调色、夸张的肌肉或人工 CGI 的修饰感。
